notes: One of the Bible's well-known scribal euphemism roots: all 4 of this root's occurrences are ketiv-only (the manuscript's actual written text), each paired with a qere (the traditional read-aloud substitute) pointing to a DIFFERENT, milder root -- שכב "lie with" (H7901) at Deut.28.30, and the same שכב-family substitution pattern at the other three. Because the ketiv text carries no vowel points in the source corpus (only the qere side is fully vocalized, and it's a different word), every heb/translit value here is bare consonants -- not a data-entry gap, but the actual state of the source text for a ketiv-only word.

This root was originally unextractable due to a pipeline bug (ketiv words were silently invisible to the extraction regex) discovered and fixed this session -- see pipeline/pipeline.py's module docstring, requirement 11.
